{{dablink|For other uses of the words "black" and "rod," see [[Black]] and [[Rod]].}}
The '''fluted black rod''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that was stolen from the [[White Tower]] by [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters]].{{Ref/book|3|25}} It was used by [[Jeaine Caide]] against [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] in the [[Panarch's Palace]] in [[Tarabon]] and later by [[Asne Zeramene]] against the [[Andoran]] force that made a rescue attempt on the kidnapped [[Elayne Trakand]].{{ref/book|11|32}}

It is assumed now in the custody of the Queen of Andor.

==Appearance==
The rod is made of black stone and is a full pace in length.{{Ref/book|3|25}}

==Use==
The rod will produce [[balefire]], but is very difficult to control it and extremely dangerous to the wielder.{{ref/book|3|25}}
